title: A roadmap commit that stages a step whose gap key matches an open step's is refused
why: One gap filed as several steps splits the work and its review: guard-pipe-on-merge-lint, verdict-pipe-masks-exit and bg-tail-loses-verdict; explore-no-create-session and reviewer-no-session-tools (b619241c4).
note: Home: roadmap/build.py check_staged on the record branch, which roadmap/hooks/pre-commit runs. Each step names its gap (a link from note to step). Done check: a red test where a commit staging a step whose gap key matches an open step's is refused, then green. From lane process-held-end-to-end's record (#1711), 20:20 CST Nov 7. It gates triage's own roadmap commits.
